messages.subject: Adding strata to genind object
parts:
I'm trying to add strata to my genind object. 

I already have individuals assigned to various populations, so when I to levels(pop(gl) it will show properly populations.

Is there any way to include "strata" information in this genind object? 

Thank you for help!

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Adding strata to genind object
parts:
Hi,

All you need is a data frame to define your strata. See the "strata" tutorial here: https://github.com/thibautjombart/adegenet/wiki/Tutorials
